description: This file contains an extension for NodeAppModel providing static methods to normalize and process watch notification parameters, actions, risk, and priority for WatchNotify data structures within the app.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes the given watch notify parameters by trimming whitespace and adjusting risk and priority.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Normalizes a list of watch actions, optionally auto-inserting default actions based on kind and prompt ID.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized risk level based on provided risk or inferred from priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized priority based on provided priority or inferred from risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string or returns nil if the string is empty after trimming.
